name: git_log
description: Show the workspace repository's most recent commits, one line each with the abbreviated hash, decorations, and subject. Read-only.

detailed: Lists recent commits from the workspace repository.

whimsical: {source} is flipping through the commit history

count.description: Optional number of commits to show (default 20, maximum 100).

timeoutSeconds.description: Optional timeout in seconds. Capped by the executor default tool timeout; a value above the cap is clamped to the cap.
